clusters.title: Colours
clusters.description: Colour is an important part of the world around us...

specific_learning_outcomes.description: Use appropriate vocabulary related to their investigations of colours. include: red, yellow, blue, orange, brown, black, white, purple, green, gray, pink, mix, light, dark, match, primary colour
glo_description: C6. employ effective communication skills and utilize information technology to gather and share scientific and technological ideas and data
D3. demonstrate a sense of responsibility for the environment and the impact of science and technology on the environment and society

specific_learning_outcomes.description: Compare and contrast colours using appropriate terms. examples: lighter than, darker than, brighter than
glo_description: C2. demonstrate an understanding of the relationships between scientific and technological concepts
D3. demonstrate a sense of responsibility for the environment and the impact of science and technology on the environment and society

specific_learning_outcomes.description: Sort and classify objects by colour.
glo_description: C2. demonstrate an understanding of the relationships between scientific and technological concepts
D3. demonstrate a sense of responsibility for the environment and the impact of science and technology on the environment and society

specific_learning_outcomes.description: Order a group of objects based on a given colour criterion. examples: order objects of same colour range from lightest to darkest
glo_description: C2. demonstrate an understanding of the relationships between scientific and technological concepts
